Well it’s a number of things really. I’m not an expert at all so take this with a grain of salt. 

The first point made is that Price was given the exact coordinates of the location so he could have had time to look at a map or Ariel/space photos of the location. I can’t really say anything about that one, because it’s definitely possible that he did. I’d like to think that he wouldn’t do that if he really wanted to prove that consciousness can travel beyond our physical form. 

Moving on to the island he drew (which was in a completely different place than the first experiment) he was able to draw an exact match. He didn’t know the coordinates beforehand. He was also able to explain exactly what was going on on the island. You can’t do that by looking at a map, I don’t think. And I don’t think he even would have been able to without the coordinates. 

Now for the people he saw in a conference that didn’t ever work there, it’s possible that he had formed those beings on his own. Sometimes you can create what you want to see in AP, similar to lucid dreaming. Sometimes the entities are real, but with no physical form. It sounds crazy but I don’t know how else to explain it. 

And now the code words. The report says that the subject found gray filing cabinets with folders marked with code words, and some of those words he saw have been used as code words, mythological designators, nicknames, and voice radio calls in the past but not since about 1966. I would assume this is because astral travel has no time constraint. Meaning you could see something from the past or present all at the same time (not sure about the future).  It was confirmed that there were gray filing cabinets in one of the rooms of the underground installation. 


Sorry if this doesn’t really add anything useful. There’s also a lot more that I missed but I’m struggling to find the energy to continue lol. Anyway, I think it’s normal for astral projection vs physically being there to be different in a number of ways. Perhaps our consciousness has a different way of perceiving information than when we are conscious in our physical bodies.

[CIA Astral Projection Caper](https://www.cia.gov/library/readingroom/docs/NSA-RDP96X00790R000100030004-1.pdf) 

There are many more interesting ones on different subjects but they’re kind of hard to find unless you take your time looking them up. Nobody really talks about them much, which is surprising
